2609.17633.title: One Color Preprocessing Improves DSATUR
2609.17633.paper_summary: The Graph Coloring Problem (GCP) is NP-hard and DSATUR stands as one of the fastest heuristics for it despite producing colorings that typically use more colors than state-of-the-art coloring algorithms. We propose SSLD (Semidefinite Spectral Learning with DSATUR), which improves DSATUR by preprocessing a first good color class before letting DSATUR complete coloring the rest of the given graph. We obtain this color class from a Semidefinite Programming (SDP), similar to an SDP used to compute the Lovász theta number. To the best of our knowledge, SSLD is the first approach to improve DSATUR by preprocessing through fixed color classes. We evaluate SSLD against DSATUR and against a naive 1-color-class preprocessing algorithm on DIMACS instances, random graphs (Erdős--Rényi, Watts-Strogatz, Barabási--Albert), Frequency Assignment and Job Shop Scheduling instances. SSLD matches or beats DSATUR in almost every case across over 1600 benchmark instances, and out performs the naive GISD baseline, allows us to confirm the value brought by the SDP-guided choice of the first color class. This quality comes at a runtime cost of roughly 195 times slower that DSATUR, but demonstrating that SDP-guided preprocessing of a first color class is a direction for future improvements.
2609.17633.paper_summary_zh: 圖著色問題（GCP）是 NP-hard，DSATUR 是其中最快的啟發式演算法之一，儘管它產生的著色通常使用比最先進的著色演算法更多的顏色。我們提出了 SSLD（使用 DSATUR 的半正定頻譜學習），它通過在讓 DSATUR 完成著色給定圖的其餘部分之前，對第一個良好顏色類進行預處理來改進 DSATUR。我們從半正定規劃（SDP）中獲得這個顏色類，類似於用於計算 Lovász theta 數的 SDP。據我們所知，SSLD 是第一個通過固定顏色類進行預處理來改進 DSATUR 的方法。我們在 DIMACS 實例、隨機圖（Erdős--Rényi、Watts-Strogatz、Barabási--Albert）、頻率分配和作業排程實例上，將 SSLD 與 DSATUR 以及一個天真的 1 顏色類預處理演算法進行比較。在超過 1600 個基準實例中，SSLD 在幾乎每種情況下都與 DSATUR 相匹配或超越，並且超越了天真的 GISD 基準，這使我們能夠確認由 SDP 指導的第一個顏色類選擇所帶來的價值。這種品質的代價是運行時間大約比 DSATUR 慢 195 倍，但顯示出由 SDP 指導的第一個顏色類的預處理是未來改進的一個方向。
2609.17633.author: Adam Nouira et.al.
